season.name: Fall
season.line: What did the year produce, what does it owe, and who will share the bread?

movement.name: The Attention
movement.line: Hear the alarm while there is time to answer.

x: Hear the end of the matter, the sum: Fear God, and keep his commandments: for this is the whole man.
For God will bring every work into judgment, with everything that has been overlooked, whether [it be] good, or whether [it be] evil.

days.t: Each of us will give an account
x: But why do you judge your brother? Or why also do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of God.
For it has been written: “[As] I live, says the Lord, every knee will bow to Me, and every tongue will confess to God.”
So then, each of us will give account concerning himself to God.

days.t: We must all appear before the judgment seat
x: For it is necessary for us all to appear before the judgment seat of Christ, so that each may receive back the things [done] through the body according to what he did, whether good or evil.
And after much time, the master of those servants comes and settles the account with them.

days.t: Naked and exposed to the eyes of him
x: And there is no created thing hidden before Him, but all things [are] bare and exposed to the eyes of Him to whom [is] our account.

And I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and books were opened. And another book was opened, which is the one of life. And the dead were judged out of the things written in the books, according to their works.
